info.longName: Global X Dow 30 Covered Call & Growth ETF

funds_data.description: The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the index. The index measures the performance of a partially covered call strategy that holds a theoretical portfolio of the underlying stocks of the Dow Jones Industrial Average® (the "Reference index"), and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money covered call options on the Reference index. The fund is non-diversified.
